Context Arena's AUC @128k/@1M, the 1M cumulative average, the per-bin scores and test counts, total runs and the latest run date stay in each row. Rows the site marks insufficient or unranked, and rows whose bins up to 128k are incomplete, are not scored. The site says results come from running models against the published GDM dataset via API; it does not state whether tools were available, which GDM's README asks every MRCR report to state. Rows the site marks insufficient or unranked, and rows whose bins up to 128k are incomplete, are not scored.
